description: Koast connects ChatGPT to your own Meta ad accounts so it can read real performance and make real changes instead of guessing. Ask how ad sets performed, which ads stopped delivering and why, where budget is pacing off, or which creatives are fatiguing. Build a campaign from a structure template, move a batch through your pipeline, adjust budgets and prepare a launch for sign-off. What ChatGPT can see and do is filtered on every request by the permission you granted, your role on the team, your plan, and what the ad account supports. Publishing is a separate permission again, and the publishing tools stay hidden until you set a spend ceiling on the connection.

defaultPrompt: How did my ad sets perform over the last 14 days?
Which of my ads aren't delivering, and why?
